<thought>By comparing the 13C NMR peaks to typical aromatic carbon chemical shift ranges (≈110–150 ppm), the peaks at 144.78, 132.00, 130.07 (two signals), and 127.80 (two signals) correspond to aromatic carbons. That gives a total of 6 aromatic carbon atoms.</thought>
